sources.games: 591 league games since 7.40 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 46.9%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py primal_beast.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in his build (86% of the won games, ~22 min); Pipe of Insight is not. Pulverize is a channel a stun breaks.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their stuns cannot break Pulverize
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб їхні оглушення не зірвали Pulverize

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 23% (2), phase_boots 99% (7), magic_wand 80% (8), soul_ring 95% (8), great_famango 24% (21), black_king_bar 86% (22), aghanims_shard 76% (23), ultimate_scepter 57% (29), shivas_guard 27% (33).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 75.0%+: 25:00 14000 (46 games, 76.1%), 30:00 16500 (47 games, 78.7%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then lead the fights and take objectives with your team
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім ведіть бійки й беріть об'єкти разом із командою

skills.basis: 591 games since 7.40: maxed primal_beast_trample > primal_beast_onslaught > primal_beast_uproar 544 (win 49.4%), primal_beast_trample > primal_beast_onslaught 41 (win 9.8%), primal_beast_trample > primal_beast_uproar > primal_beast_onslaught 4 (win 100.0%); talents 10: +30 Damage 295/449 (46.8%), +25% Magic Resistance During Trample 154/449 (44.8%); 15: -5s Trample Cooldown 290/495 (52.4%), +6 Uproar Armor Per Stack 205/495 (49.3%); 20: +20% Trample Attack Multiplier 189/335 (64.6%), Basic Self-Dispel on Uproar Cast 146/335 (56.2%); 25: +67% Pulverize Duration 89/107 (70.8%), special_bonus_unique_primal_beast_colossal_trample 18/107 (66.7%).
